title: Learning from mistakes sheet
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y5 lesson 8 (Learning from mistakes sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 8: Being an effective learner: trying again. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Not this
This
rows: Everyone learns by making mistakes and fixing them

model.title: I got 4/10 on my times tables.

parts.text: What went wrong: the 7 and 8 tables
Why: I had not practised them
Next time: 5 minutes a day on those two

frame.label: What will I do next time?

keywords.def: doing something again to get better
an error we can learn from
keeping going when it is hard (sabr)

questions.q: Turn into growth: 'I'll never be good at writing.'
questions.a: For example: 'I'm getting better at writing with practice.'

questions.q: Core: Write about one mistake you learned from using the three questions (pupil PDF).
questions.a: A real example with what, why and next time.

questions.q: Extend: Make a poster of five growth statements.
Stretch: Explain why perseverance (sabr) matters in learning the Qur'an or maths.
questions.a: Progress comes slowly with practice; giving up stops progress.

options: I can't do it yet, I'll practise
questions.a: B) I can't do it yet, I'll practise. 'Yet' and a plan show we can improve with effort.

questions.q: Perseverance means... A) giving up B) keeping going when it is hard C) copying
questions.a: B) keeping going when it is hard
options: Keeping going when it is hard

questions.q: Big question: is a mistake a failure or a step forward?
questions.a: A step forward when we learn from it.
